answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake before submitting jobs, and increase the stake for accounts that interact mostly within a closed cluster. Audits can delay withdrawals from clusters lacking independent links to established agents. This makes a Sybil attacker fund many identities with real capital, keep it locked, and risk losing access across the cluster. A ripple of new accounts, even with comet-like bursts or a wharf of mutual endorsements, cannot cheaply bypass the cost.
